methodology: Re-tokenize each completed Experiment 004 output with the source model tokenizer. At every non-repeated detector position, classify the full SynthID n-gram as reused when the identical token-id tuple appears anywhere in that document's marked source; otherwise classify it as novel. Sum binary g-values separately for both partitions and fit per-document meanG against exact n-gram reuse fraction.

sources.title: SynthID-Text: watermarking large language model output
